question: As on June 2023, the Executive Directors of the World Bank selected Ajay Banga, as the ________ President of the World Bank for a five-year term.
solution:
The correct answer __**14th**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• ** Ajay Banga was selected 14th President **of the World Bank Group.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__
